Euchre is a trick-taking card game usually played by four players in two teams.
Cards: • Uses cards 9 through Ace (24 cards total)
Trump: • One suit is chosen as trump each round • Jack of trump suit is the strongest card (Right Bower) • Jack of same color is second strongest (Left Bower)
Gameplay: • Each player gets 5 cards • Players must follow suit if possible • Highest card wins the trick • There are 5 tricks per round
Scoring: • Team that chose trump wins 1 point for 3–4 tricks • Winning all 5 tricks gives 2 points • If the choosing team fails, opponents get 2 points
Goal: • First team to reach 10 points wins
